head.re: Illustrative example — late-payment charge on tax paid 30 days late
head.scope: Illustrative shape only — do not reuse its content. Made-up act, rates and amounts.

summary.conclusion: A late-payment charge of KRW 330,000 is due.
summary.basis: It is a fixed charge of KRW 300,000 plus a daily charge of KRW 30,000 under the made-up Example Tax Act.[^a10][^a11]

summary.conclusion: The charge keeps running until the tax is paid.
summary.basis: Each further day adds KRW 1,000 at the illustrative daily rate.[^a11]

summary.conclusion: A reduction is possible only on application.
summary.basis: The made-up act lets the tax office halve the fixed charge where the taxpayer applies within the period.[^a12]

question: Is a late-payment charge due when tax of KRW 10,000,000 is paid 30 days after the deadline, and how much?

short_answer.conditions: This holds if the unpaid tax was KRW 10,000,000, payment was 30 days late and no reduction has been granted.

facts.text: Payment was made 30 days after the deadline.
No reduction has been applied for.

analysis.heading: A charge arises once the deadline passes unpaid
analysis.rule: Tax not paid by the deadline attracts a late-payment charge.[^a10]
analysis.application: The tax was paid 30 days after the deadline.

analysis.heading: The charge is a fixed 3 percent plus 0.01 percent a day
analysis.rule: The charge is 3 percent of the unpaid tax plus 0.01 percent of the unpaid tax for each day of delay.[^a10][^a11]
analysis.application: 3 percent of KRW 10,000,000 is KRW 300,000, and 0.01 percent a day for 30 days is KRW 30,000.

analysis.heading: A reduction needs an application within the period
analysis.rule: The tax office may halve the fixed charge where the taxpayer applies within the period set by the act.[^a12]
analysis.application: No application has been made on the facts given.
analysis.conclusion: No reduction applies unless an application is filed in time.
analysis.confirm: The application deadline and whether the delay had a cause the act recognises.

risks.why: The daily charge depends on the exact payment date.
risks.check: The bank record of the payment date.

risks.why: The fixed charge could be halved if an application is still possible.[^a12]
risks.check: Whether the application period is still open.

risks.why: Every rate and amount here is made up to show the form.
risks.check: Replace each figure and citation with tool results.

next_steps.action: Confirm the payment date from the bank record.
Decide whether to apply for the reduction.
